Name: Gifts from Krobus - A Gentle Shadow of the Sewers
Author: LoganDoidao989
Description:
[center][b][size=5]Gifts from Krobus – A Gentle Shadow of the Sewers[/size][/b][/center]
[center]
Deep beneath Pelican Town, in the quiet damp of the sewers, Krobus lives a life apart from the surface world—observing, learning, and slowly growing attached to those few he comes to trust. This mod expands that quiet connection, giving Krobus a more personal and expressive way to show his friendship toward the player.
As your relationship with Krobus deepens, he begins to reach out in his own subtle way. Through carefully chosen deliveries and thoughtful gestures, he shares fragments of his world—small tokens that reflect his mysterious nature, his curiosity about life above, and his sincere appreciation for your companionship. These are not grand gestures, but gentle ones, consistent with who Krobus is: reserved, kind, and deeply sincere.[/center]
[center][/center]
